name: Can rental property restoration improve tenant retention and rental income?

mainEntity.name: Can rental property restoration improve tenant retention and rental income?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, investing in quality rental property restoration can significantly improve tenant retention and potentially increase rental income. A well-maintained and updated property attracts higher-quality tenants who are often willing to pay more for a desirable living space. It also reduces tenant turnover, which saves landlords money on marketing, vacancy periods, and repeated cleaning or repairs between tenants.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, quality restoration attracts better tenants, potentially increases rent, and improves retention, reducing turnover costs.
